newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton market follows higher New York.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton market follows higher New York.

text.p: Renewed strength on the New York futures market influenced sentiment in Europe, prompting a rise in trade offers, industry sources said.

Most prospective mill buyers retreated to the sidelines as prices rose, although there had been some recent indications of more positive underlying spinner demand in several parts of Europe, they added.
Further events in New York would be followed closely before the long holiday weekend in the United States. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8074
